about_the_game:
"Falling through the endless abyss..."

"Five Munutes... 2 Years? I don't know how long it's been..."

"What if I never stop falling..."

The game to end ALL games!

Infinite Hole Simulator is a ONCE IN A LIFETIME experience, fall down a hole, and keep falling FOREVER!

Changes from the April Fools version

  • More lore accurate

    • For example Freya will no longer have any lines and characters will comment on it.

Features

Fall down hole FOREVER

Jump in and fall forever. You NEVER get to come out!

LORE

Why you may ask? Well because we CAN! Can you all through into the Under-Realm and escape the town stuck out of time? You'll find out!

Other Features

  • Full RPG-combat system

  • NPCs to help tell the unique story we want to tell

  • Multiple ingame locations to explore

  • A definitely infinite hole that'll DEFENITELY never end.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game includes implied nudity (though no nudity is explicitly shown, it is implied within the game).

This game contains "edgy" humour and fantasy violence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel or AMD, 2.5GHz or Faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: None
  • Additional Notes: The System Requirements are based on the requirements for Unreal Engine 5. We do not have the capabilities to run the game using less specifications.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 - 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-Core Intel or AMD, 2.5GHz or Faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 SUPER
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: None
  • Additional Notes: The System Requirements are based on the requirements for Unreal Engine 5. We do not have the capabilities to run the game using less specifications.
